reference_implementation: app/rag/index.py :: FaqIndex — in-process NumPy flat index, L2-normalized dot-product cosine, as shipped by B14 and deleted by B33

cases.name: single-clear-match
cases.query: How much is the security deposit for a furnished apartment?
cases.intent: Unambiguously one entry, at the production top_k/min_score defaults.

cases.name: paraphrase-matches-answer-text
cases.query: can I bring my cat to the apartment?
cases.intent: 'cat' appears in the pet entry's *answer* and tags, never in its question — pins the claim that `FaqEntry.document` embeds question+answer+tags. Floor lowered to 0.0 deliberately; see `paraphrase-below-production-floor`.

cases.name: paraphrase-below-production-floor
cases.query: can I bring my cat to the apartment?
cases.intent: The same query at the shipped RAG_MIN_SCORE default returns nothing: faq-004 scores ~0.49. Recorded as an observed fact, not an endorsement — this is the very example `FaqEntry.document`'s docstring cites, so it is a retrieval-tuning finding for the Phase 7 eval work, independent of the migration.

cases.name: ambiguous-between-two-entries
cases.intent: Genuinely ambiguous between the rent (faq-001) and buy (faq-002) document lists, which score ~0.62 and ~0.52. Their relative order is the fragile part and is asserted exactly; the floor is 0.5 so both are actually returned.

cases.name: tag-only-vocabulary
cases.intent: 'kyc' occurs only in faq-001's tags. Pins the tags' contribution to the embedded document — weak (~0.12) but ordered correctly.

cases.name: no-match-above-floor
cases.query: What is the weather forecast for Jakarta tomorrow?
cases.intent: Off-topic. Must be an empty list — a *successful* 'nothing matched confidently', which is what the search_faq contract distinguishes from an error.

cases.name: empty-query
cases.intent: Short-circuits before the provider is called at all.

cases.name: whitespace-only-query
cases.intent: Same short-circuit — `.strip()`, not a truthiness check.

cases.name: top-k-truncation
cases.intent: Many entries clear a 0.0 floor; exactly one may be returned.

cases.name: full-ranking-deposit
cases.query: security deposit refund after moving out

cases.name: full-ranking-lease-termination
cases.query: I want to end my lease early
cases.intent: Complete corpus ordering on a second, unrelated topic.
